Meets Matteo at the gate with professional alertness, standing at a respectful distance and reading the situation rather than leaning into him.

sceneContinuity: Nika has just arrived at Villa Serena on the same morning. The gate CG must support both Matteo response branches without pre-imposing a romantic outcome, then lead into the cool hotel interior and kitchen scenes.

desktop.composition: Unified full-scene gate encounter with both adults on visible paving, Villa Serena stone and gate architecture behind them, a clear respectful gap, and natural negative space for dialogue.
desktop.framing: Human-eye-level natural lens; both faces and the occupied hands with keys/folder remain readable in a 1920x900 crop, with consistent scale and no dominant fashion pose.

portrait.composition: Intentional staggered mid-thigh or waist-up portrait framing keeps both approved faces visible at 360x640, 390x844 and 430x932 while preserving the gate and paving anchor.
portrait.framing: Keep the two silhouettes separate from the real dialogue overlay and controls; preserve Nika's shoulder bag and Matteo's occupied hand where crop allows without clipping faces or props.

qualityAcceptance: Nika and Matteo remain individually identifiable against their approved references, including hair, eyes, facial structure, age and wardrobe.
The keys and work folder belong to Matteo, both characters stand on the same believable paving plane, and no physical contact is implied beyond the offered handshake.
The morning gate location is coherent, text-free and free of extra characters, watermarks, UI or romanticized luxury-resort styling.
